data.title: Okanagan Valley
data.summary: A ten-night slow stay hosted in a private chalet above Kelowna, exploring Canada’s premier wine valley, scenic trails, and seasonal gastronomy.
data.description: Ten nights and nine days in British Columbia, based in a chalet on Big White Mountain above Kelowna. Each day opens onto the region differently: cycling the historic wooden trestle bridges of Myra Canyon, tastings at wineries with long views, a boat trip on Lake Okanagan, moderate hikes beside lakes that change colour. There is room for the urban and cultural side of the valley too, with chosen stops in Kelowna, Lake Country, Vernon, Peachland and Osoyoos. A niche trip, away from the busy routes, built so what you bring home actually stays.
data.territory: Okanagan Valley is British Columbia's main wine region: hundreds of vineyards and wineries spread along the lake and the hills around it. A region of lakes, vines, open landscapes and small towns with an identity of their own.
data.audience: For adults who want authentic places, a sustainable pace, and a shared experience built with intention and care.
data.climate: On Big White Mountain, where the chalet is, the summer is cool and dry: 22–28 °C. Around Kelowna, Lake Country, Vernon and Osoyoos it is hotter and drier: 25–35 °C.

team.name: Federica Caglioti
team.bio: Art Director and founder of Studio Superbo, with an international creative career. She hosts this Off The Map trip and sets its rhythm, shaping an experience that puts together local culture, places with a real connection to nature, and moments that stay in your memory rather than only your phone's.

team.name: Nora Maria Loya Ledesma
team.bio: A chef with more than fifteen years across Spain, the United States, Mexico and Canada. She cooks this edition of Off The Map, with global influences and local ingredients, and curates the food experiences of the region — including a guide to local options for the meals that are on your own.

blocks.title: Lunch

blocks.title: Free afternoon

blocks.title: Breakfast
blocks.description: Breakfast and briefing.

blocks.title: Fruit picking

blocks.title: Lunch by the lake

blocks.title: Summerhill Pyramid Winery

blocks.title: Dinner

blocks.description: Named Canada's best winery six times in recent years. A walk through the estate and its grounds.

blocks.title: Cooking with the chef

blocks.title: Dinner

blocks.title: Kalamalka Lake
blocks.description: Out to Kalamalka Lake, 75 minutes — named by National Geographic among the ten most beautiful lakes in the world.

blocks.title: Lunch
blocks.description: At a café in Vernon chosen by the chef.

blocks.title: Free afternoon

blocks.title: Dinner
